questions.q: What does the summary claim about war in human history?
a: Long stretches of peace outweigh brief periods of war
War has been a constant feature of every era
War disappeared once farming began
Only modern societies fought organized wars
questions.why: Lesson 1 challenges Churchill's claim that the human story is war.

questions.q: What does research on the walls of Jericho suggest?
a: They may have guarded against mudflows, not enemies
They were built to repel invading armies
They were never actually constructed
They were rebuilt after an earthquake
questions.why: Lesson 1 says archaeology points to a defensive purpose against nature.

questions.q: What is synchrony, as the summary describes it?
a: An unconscious matching of behavior that builds bonds
A learned habit taught in early childhood
A conscious choice to cooperate with strangers
A reaction found only in human beings
questions.why: Lesson 2 links it to contagious yawning and birds flying in formation.

questions.q: What did the chimpanzee yawning experiment show?
a: Yawning spreads contagiously among apes too
Apes only yawn when they are tired
Apes ignore videos of other apes
Yawning signals aggression in primates
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes apes yawning after watching footage of yawning chimps.

questions.q: What did Ulf Dimberg's study find?
a: People automatically mimic the expressions they see
People can switch empathy off when asked
Facial expressions have no effect on mood
Only trained actors can read facial cues
questions.why: Lesson 3 says participants smiled at happy faces and frowned at angry ones.
